request: Continue researching new factors: Sharpe above 1 and outperform the broad market.

sources.title: Residual momentum
sources.adaptation: Daily 756-session SPY-only excess-return regression, not the paper's stock-level multifactor replication. Rank the last 12-minus-1-month residual sum divided by its residual standard deviation.

sources.title: Frog in the Pan: Continuous Information and Momentum
sources.adaptation: ETF proxy: equal rank mixture of 12-minus-1-month return and negative information discreteness. Discreteness is the sign of that return times the fraction of negative minus positive daily returns.

sources.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
sources.adaptation: Monthly inverse-realized-variance exposure with ex-ante fixed reference volatility, capped at the cash-funded budget. No full-sample normalization, shorting or margin.

methodology.observation: Only completed NYSE month ends; decisions use observations through that close and execute at a later session open.
methodology.sector_allocation: Positive raw skip-month momentum and price above trailing 200-session mean; rank the declared factor, allocate inverse trailing 63-session volatility across at most three ETFs, scale missing slots proportionally, cap each at 40%, put remaining invested budget in actual BIL.
methodology.residual_information: The intercept and market beta are estimated anew from trailing data at each decision. Fitted coefficients and all residual-score observations precede execution.
methodology.growth_gold: QLD and GLD receive inverse-63-session-volatility weights. The managed variant scales the risky basket by fixed reference variance divided by its last-21-session covariance estimate, at most one; residual budget goes to BIL.
methodology.leverage: No account borrowing or synthetic leveraged history. QLD has actual embedded daily-reset 2x leverage, whose historical fees and decay remain in observed prices.
methodology.benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold, same starting capital, sessions and modeled transaction assumptions; stress must also beat the base-cost SPY CAGR.
methodology.data: Reuse existing hashed historical snapshots without changing retrieval timestamps or treating old data as first observed today.
methodology.selection: All eight configurations, including controls, are disclosed. No parameter grid, post-result retuning, random train/test split or promotion of an exposed interval to a holdout.
methodology.uncertainty: Paired 21-session block bootstrap intervals are conditional diagnostics, not selection-adjusted confidence or future-return guarantees.
methodology.forward: Old paused forward observations remain untouched. No broker, holdings, Slack send or automatic trading action.
